question: Can equilibrium-consistent boundary changes move geodesic/compression and bad-curvature/compression independently enough to test them?
calculation: At three typical unstable anchors, compute VMEC boundary-coefficient Jacobians and search both signed directions for each candidate while recomputing force-balanced equilibria.
why_information_gain_is_high: It tests whether the proposed causal intervention exists before any GX expenditure; failure immediately removes or replaces an arm.
minimum_success: candidate movement >= 0.5 panel IQR and every registered constraint drift <= 0.1 panel IQR in both signs at all three anchors
estimated_cost: 2 Perlmutter node-hours planning allowance; no GX runs
decision_gate: researcher approval required before external compute
validity_tag_if_run: plausibly-local until equilibrium checks pass; then equilibrium-consistent intervention candidate

question: What is the measured cost and numerical stability of the proposed GX intervention?
calculation: After N01 passes, run one standard and one doubled-resolution/averaging case before requesting the full allocation.
why_information_gain_is_high: It replaces assumed 0.5/2.0 node-hour costs and tests the registered <=20% convergence rule.
minimum_success: response keeps sign, changes <=20% at higher resolution, and exceeds two combined Q_stds standard errors
estimated_cost: one standard plus one convergence case; measure rather than assume
decision_gate: requires N01 feasibility and researcher approval

question: Do controlled geodesic/compression or bad-curvature/compression changes cause native log-heat-flux changes?
calculation: Run the registered 24 standard GX cases and six decisive convergence cases from S13.
why_information_gain_is_high: This is the first calculation able to promote a candidate from observational-physical to physically supported.
minimum_success: paired response >=0.2 native-log units, >2 combined Q_stds errors, sign stable across anchors/drives, convergence rule satisfied
estimated_cost: 32.5 node-hours planning envelope, revised after N02
decision_gate: requires N01/N02 and researcher budget approval

question: Is the apparent bad-curvature sign reversal with a/L_T real in the network?
calculation: Compute paired equilibrium-grouped finite differences or exact mixed derivatives for the canonical top members and an interval on the high-minus-low contrast.
why_information_gain_is_high: It resolves the sharpest remaining model-mechanistic regime hypothesis without claiming plasma causality.
minimum_success: grouped interval for the high-minus-low contrast excludes zero with member-level signs retained
estimated_cost: small local model calculation; no new GX
decision_gate: none; subordinate to N01 for physical uncertainty
validity_tag_if_run: plausibly-local model diagnostic unless an equilibrium-consistent path is used

question: Do the compact formula, physical ranking, and spread diagnostics generalize beyond equilibria seen in training?
calculation: Evaluate a prospectively selected equilibrium-family holdout with the registered native estimands and group-level uncertainty.
why_information_gain_is_high: Every present panel equilibrium appeared in training; this addresses external generalization rather than interpolation.
minimum_success: pre-registered effect signs and fidelity/error diagnostics reproduce without reselecting candidates
estimated_cost: depends on available held-out GX archive or new simulation campaign
validity_tag_if_run: observed-comparison unless new controlled GX interventions are included
